title: [EXA-10] Relay sync `Envelope` object does not match the routing envelope
description: Review finding EXA-10: Relay sync `Envelope` object does not match the routing envelope (lens EXA). Location: spec/11-transport.md:331-339. Fix: Use the reviewer's second form, `{id, channelToken, receivedAt, envelope: <base64url exact bytes>}`. It composes with the EXA-1 fix. Drop `seqNo`, `encryptedPayload` and the ULID `id`. Full text: notes/review/EXA-verified.md and notes/review/EXA.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: spec/11-transport.md §11.8 Envelope object is {id (envelope CID), channelToken, envelope (base64url exact bytes), receivedAt, expiresAt}; seqNo/encryptedPayload gone from spec
